meta.title: Version control panel
meta.description: Adds a version control view to every conversation for Git and Jujutsu repositories: working changes with file diffs, plus commit history with a lane graph and commit details. Browsing is read-only apart from two actions: the branch menu checks out an existing local branch, and Sync fetches a Git branch’s upstream, then fast-forwards or pushes. It never stages, commits, merges, rebases, force-pushes, discards changes, creates branches, or rewrites commits or bookmarks. Jujutsu may snapshot the working copy while reading.
